title: Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning

extra.description: The rapid proliferation of memecoins on blockchain platforms has increased the risk of fraudulent activities, particularly rug pulls. While previous studies have focused on Ethereum-based tokens, this paper shifts the spotlight to Solana, the leading blockchain for memecoins by trading volume and token count.
